name: Novel / unexplained outbreaks
summary: No unexplained cluster under international investigation found by 18 Nov; UKHSA lists only known pathogens
state: UKHSA's weekly list of outbreaks under monitoring for the week to 1 Nov covers known pathogens (UKHSA). Searches to 18 Nov found no unexplained cluster or novel pathogen under international investigation, so the level stays Normal.
for_you: No action needed. UKHSA and WHO publish updates if a new outbreak is identified.
rubric_hit: No unexplained cluster under investigation = Normal

sources.title: UKHSA — Outbreaks under monitoring, week 44 (week ending 1 November 2026)

why: The next pandemic will start as an unexplained cluster; early signals matter.
drivers: Surveillance reports, unknown illnesses, new pathogens.
